A '''masking code modulator''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] system that modified the vessel's [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]]. When in use, the modulator modified the starship's transponder code, making it appear as a completely new one, or one that was similar to another vessel's. The ship then appeared on records as another ship of the same model.<ref name="PP" />
